task: Track 2 — example test data (controlled) for POST /advise classification
notes: Precedence: KMV Annex 1 (war materiel list, KM 1-22) always prevails. An item that is war materiel is NOT a specific military good under GKV Annex 3.
KM numbers mirror ML numbers but the KM list is a subset: KM 14, 15, 18 and 22 contain no entries, so e.g. ML15 (night vision / thermal) items stay `specific_military` under GKV Annex 3.
KM 1 covers only hand and pistol firearms of any calibre (Hand- und Faustfeuerwaffen); other weapons (rifles, machine guns, mortars, cannons) are KM 2.
Each entry's `request` is a ready-to-send /advise payload (item block only).
`expected` is the ground truth for scoring: controlled flag, regime, control list entries.
Entries cite GKV Annex 2 (dual-use list), e.g. '3A001.a.5.a' is shorthand for the specific paragraph.
specifications are deliberately free-form (varied keys/units), matching the API contract.
Several not-controlled items sit exactly on the threshold boundary (thresholds are strict '>' unless stated otherwise).
